questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the present perfect tense?
options: She has finished her homework yesterday.
She finishes her homework tomorrow.
She has finished her homework already.
She finished her homework yesterday.
questions.answer: She has finished her homework already.

questions.question: Choose the correct form of the verb in the past conditional sentence.
options: If I had studied harder, I passed the exam.
If I had studied harder, I would pass the exam.
If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
If I had studied harder, I will pass the exam.
questions.answer: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.

questions.question: Which option correctly compares two things using comparatives?
options: This book is more interesting than that one.
This book is more interesting to that one.
This book is more interesting from that one.
This book is more interesting with that one.
questions.answer: This book is more interesting than that one.

questions.question: Select the correct modal verb for giving advice.
options: You _____ drive so carefully!
You must drive so carefully!
You should drive so carefully!
You can drive so carefully!

questions.question: Which sentence uses the gerund correctly?
options: I enjoy painting pictures in my free time.
I enjoy to painting pictures in my free time.
I enjoy paints pictures in my free time.
I enjoy paint pictures in my free time.
questions.answer: I enjoy painting pictures in my free time.

questions.question: Choose the correct linker to connect the sentences smoothly.
options: After the rain stopped, we continued our journey.
Although the rain stopped, we continued our journey.
Because the rain stopped, we continued our journey.
Despite the rain stopped, we continued our journey.
questions.answer: Although the rain stopped, we continued our journey.

questions.question: Which word best completes the sentence about environmental issues?
options: The government is taking measures to reduce pollution.
The government is taking measures to reduce pollution.
The government is taking measures to reduce pollution.
The government is taking measures to reduce pollution.
questions.answer: The government is taking measures to reduce pollution.

questions.question: Select the correct option that uses the present perfect correctly in the context of experience.
options: I have never visited Paris, but I want to.
I never visited Paris, but I want to.
I have never visited Paris, but I want to.
I never visited Paris, but I want to.
questions.answer: I have never visited Paris, but I want to.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the second conditional for hypothetical situations?
options: If I won the lottery, I buy a house.
If I win the lottery, I buy a house.
If I won the lottery, I would buy a house.
If I win the lottery, I will buy a house.
questions.answer: If I won the lottery, I would buy a house.

questions.question: Choose the appropriate word to complete the sentence about daily routines.
options: She gets up at 7 am every morning.
She got up at 7 am every morning.
She gets up at 7 am every morning.
She get up at 7 am every morning.
questions.answer: She gets up at 7 am every morning.
